quarterly_data.quarter: Tempus AI press release: Tempus Receives FDA Clearance for its ECG-MR AI Product (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Tempus received 510(k) clearance from the U.S. FDA for Tempus ECG-MR, an AI product that analyzes standard 12-lead resting electrocardiograms to detect signs associated with undiagnosed moderate or severe mitral regurgitation, for use on clinical diagnostic ECG recordings from patients 65 years of age or older at risk of cardiovascular disease; it provides a binary output and is not intended as a stand-alone diagnostic tool. ECG-MR becomes the fourth FDA-cleared Tempus ECG-AI product, spanning arrhythmia, heart function, pulmonary vascular and valvular disease. SVP of Cardiology Brandon Fornwalt: with the fourth FDA-cleared ECG-AI product, 'we're building a growing portfolio that can identify signals across numerous types of heart and vascular disease from the same ECG.'
